cornerstone.notes: No cornerstone investors. p121 states verbatim: 'On the basis that there are no cornerstone investors, 85,162,500 H Shares, which are to be newly issued under the Global Offering (representing 11.00% of our total issued Shares immediately upon Listing) will be freely tradable'. Searched 'cornerstone' across all 427 pages: only p121 (statement of absence), p145 and p208 (generic uses of the word).

controller_6m.full_quote: Undertaking by our Controlling Shareholders Pursuant to Rule 10.07(1) of the Listing Rules, each of the Controlling Shareholders undertakes to the Stock Exchange and to our Company that except pursuant to the Global Offering, they will not at any time: (a) during the period commencing on the date by reference to which disclosure of his/its interests in our Company is made in this prospectus and ending on the date falling six months from the Listing Date (the “First Six-month Period”), he/it shall not dispose of, or enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of, any of the securities of our Company in respect of which he/it is shown by this prospectus to be the beneficial owners; or
controller_6m.basis: Rule 10.07(1)(a): period commencing on the prospectus disclosure date and ending on the date falling six months from the Listing Date; inclusive end date, so the first free day is the day after the six-month anniversary
controller_6m.notes: Issuer cites Rule 19A.13C (H-share chapter); Rule 10.07 undertaking given in the standard form.

controller_12m.full_quote: (b) in the six-month period commencing on the expiry of the First Six-month Period set out in paragraph (a) above, dispose of, or enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of, any of the securities mentioned in paragraph (a) if, immediately following such disposal or upon the exercise or enforcement of such options, rights, interests or encumbrances, he/it would cease to be a controlling shareholder of our Company for the purposes of the Listing Rules.
controller_12m.basis: Rule 10.07(1)(b): six-month period commencing on the expiry of the First Six-month Period, i.e. running to 12 months from the Listing Date, conditional on ceasing to be a controlling shareholder; first free day is the day after the 12-month anniversary
